title: UniverseTemplate
description: A universe as data, not code (0000 §6, 0009): a pre-authored chain for the resolver to fold (0007), a roster of StampOrders (0011), profiles with a clock (0004). The provisioner renders it into a running universe — same artifact for compose (dev) and CDK (cloud). Locked 2026-07-02: first templates League · Second Brain · Company; tone defaults REAL, templates override; wild-vs-REAL modulates RIGOR, never safety — platform floors are identical at both ends.

trust_tier_required.description: The 0013 §8 door: a template above the requester's tier refuses to render. A 'regulated' template is structurally unavailable until the Custodian org can meet its quorums (0012 — bars are absolute).

tone.description: The template's own dial position (blank universes default REAL, locked 2026-07-02). Modulates signal_capture, judge sampling, retention classes — NEVER the platform floors.

clock_mode.description: declared ⇒ an accelerated universe (the League simulates seasons overnight, 0004 §1).

profile_dials.description: TierProfile fragments per tier — the provisioner completes scope/trust_root/signature at render time and validates the result against tier-profile.schema.json. Anonymous-tier renders CLAMP stamp_quota and budgets to the platform caps (0013 §8) — the safety architecture is the free-tier economics.

floors.description: Starter policy floors — published at the universe on render, cascaded from breath one.

soft.description: The tone made concrete — soft standards seeded at the apex (most-specific-wins thereafter).

archetype.description: Archetype name — issued at the universe, stamped into fields (0011).

fuel.description: Locked 2026-07-02 (#14): charge by fuel, not by time. One-time free allotment; out of fuel ⇒ HIBERNATE, never delete — the window stays watchable, agents pause ('it dreams only when fueled'); wake by subscription or bring-your-own model key; idle ⇒ hibernate regardless.
